# UI and composed components

*Describes silverpoint 0.8.0.*

Every component is named `Sp<Name>` in the three frameworks (`SpButton`, `<sp-input>`), imported
from its own subpath (`@silverpoint/react/ui/button`), and drawn in the same ground as the
charts. Import `@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css` once, after `styles.css`.

## Binding a value

| | Controlled | Uncontrolled | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| React | `value` (`checked` for Checkbox and Switch) | `defaultValue` (`defaultChecked`) | `onChange(value)`: the value, not the DOM event |
| Vue | `v-model` | omit `v-model`, pass `default-value` | `update:modelValue`, then `change` on commit |
| Angular | `[(value)]`, or `formControl` / `ngModel` | `[defaultValue]` | `(valueChange)` |

Value events fire on user input only, never on a prop change, and never for a disabled component
or item. Angular value components are `ControlValueAccessor`s, so they work in reactive and
template-driven forms.

## Server rendering

In React, display components also have server entries (`@silverpoint/react/server/ui/<name>`):
`card`, `tag`, `badge`, `divider`, `progress`, `alert`, `skeleton`, `steps`, `surface`, `glyph`,
`table` (unsortable), `breadcrumb`, `avatar`, `statistic`, `descriptions`, `timeline-list`, `empty`
and `result`. Every other component is a client component.

## Notes

- `SpButton` is an attribute component in Angular (`<button spButton>`, `<a spButton>`), so your own
  element is the control. `SpSurface` is `[spSurface]` in the same way.
- `SpTabs` renders `SpTabPanel` children matched by `value`.
- `SpTable` draws its rows as given: sort them yourself on `onSort` (`@sort`, `(sort)`), which also
  keeps paging with `SpPagination` correct.
- A link's `href` (`SpButton`, `SpBreadcrumb`) keeps relative URLs and the `http`, `https`,
  `mailto` and `tel` schemes. Any other is dropped with `SP017`.
- Named content: React takes node props, Vue slots (`prefix`, `suffix`, `extra`, `footer`), and
  Angular templates (`<ng-template spExtra>`, `spFooter`, `spPrefix`, `spSuffix`).

## SpButton

`button` · A button or a link styled as one; `primary` and `danger` variants. (actions)

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `SpButton` | `SpButton` | `button[spButton]` | `sp_button` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/ui/button` | `@silverpoint/vue/ui/button` | `@silverpoint/angular/ui/button` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Events:** React `onClick`; Vue `click`; Angular .

**Content:** React `children`; Vue `default`; Angular `content`.

**States:** `default`, `primary`, `danger`, `disabled`.

### Props

Its own props, beside the common ones (`id`, `seed`, `ground`, `substrate`, `mode`, `palette`, `size`, `className`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `UiVariant` | `'default'` | Default `'default'`; `danger` also draws the exact ✕ glyph (REQ-310). |
| `type` | `'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'` | `'button'` | Default `'button'`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Not focusable, not submitted; drawn with the disabled tone. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of an icon-only button (REQ-319). |
| `block` | `boolean` |  | Fills the width of its container. |
| `href` | `string` |  | Renders an `<a>`. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css';
import { SpButton } from '@silverpoint/react/ui/button';

export function ButtonView() {
  return (
    <SpButton>
      Default
    </SpButton>
  );
}
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css';
import { SpButton } from '@silverpoint/vue/ui/button';
</script>

<template>
  <SpButton>
    Default
  </SpButton>
</template>
```

```ts angular
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component } from '@angular/core';
import { SpButton } from '@silverpoint/angular/ui/button';

/** Add '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css', '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css', '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css' to the `styles` of angular.json. */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-button-view',
  imports: [SpButton],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <button
      spButton
    >
      Default
    </button>
  `,
})
export class ButtonView {}
```

## SpInput

`input` · A labelled text field with an optional message and an invalid state. (data-entry)

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `SpInput` | `SpInput` | `sp-input` | `sp_input` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/ui/input` | `@silverpoint/vue/ui/input` | `@silverpoint/angular/ui/input` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Value:** React `value + onChange`, Vue `v-model`, Angular `[(value)]`.

**Events:** React `onChange`; Vue `change`; Angular .

**Content:** React `prefix`, `suffix`; Vue `prefix`, `suffix`; Angular `spPrefix`, `spSuffix`.

**States:** `empty`, `filled`, `invalid`, `disabled`.

### Props

Its own props, beside the common ones (`id`, `seed`, `ground`, `substrate`, `mode`, `palette`, `size`, `className`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `'text' \| 'search' \| 'email' \| 'url' \| 'tel' \| 'password' \| 'number'` | `'text'` | Native input type. Default `'text'`. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  | Hint shown while empty; not a substitute for the accessible name. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Form field name; the native input submits under it (REQ-323). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Not focusable and not submitted. |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` |  | Focusable and submitted, but not editable. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  | Sets `aria-invalid` and draws the exact ⚠ glyph (REQ-334). |
| `message` | `string` |  | Help or error text under the control, referenced by `aria-describedby` (REQ-334). |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name, when no `<label for>` names the control. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { SpInput } from '@silverpoint/react/ui/input';

export function InputView() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<string>('');
  return (
    <SpInput
      label="Search charts"
      placeholder="Search charts…"
      type="search"
      name="q"
      value={value}
      onChange={setValue}
    />
  );
}
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css';
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { SpInput } from '@silverpoint/vue/ui/input';

const value = ref<string>('');
</script>

<template>
  <SpInput
    label="Search charts"
    placeholder="Search charts…"
    type="search"
    name="q"
    v-model="value"
  />
</template>
```

```ts angular
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { SpInput } from '@silverpoint/angular/ui/input';

/** Add '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css', '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css', '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css' to the `styles` of angular.json. */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-input-view',
  imports: [SpInput],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <sp-input
      [label]="'Search charts'"
      [placeholder]="'Search charts…'"
      [type]="'search'"
      [name]="'q'"
      [(value)]="value"
    />
  `,
})
export class InputView {
  protected readonly value = signal<string>('');
}
```

## SpCheckbox

`checkbox` · A labelled checkbox, with an indeterminate state. (data-entry)

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `SpCheckbox` | `SpCheckbox` | `sp-checkbox` | `sp_checkbox` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/ui/checkbox` | `@silverpoint/vue/ui/checkbox` | `@silverpoint/angular/ui/checkbox` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Value:** React `checked + onChange`, Vue `v-model`, Angular `[(value)]`.

**Events:** React `onChange`; Vue `change`; Angular .

**States:** `unchecked`, `checked`, `indeterminate`, `disabled`.

### Props

Its own props, beside the common ones (`id`, `seed`, `ground`, `substrate`, `mode`, `palette`, `size`, `className`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|

## SpRadioGroup

`radio-group` · One choice among a few, as a fieldset of radios. (data-entry)

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `SpRadioGroup` | `SpRadioGroup` | `sp-radio-group` | `sp_radio_group` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/ui/radio-group` | `@silverpoint/vue/ui/radio-group` | `@silverpoint/angular/ui/radio-group` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Value:** React `value + onChange`, Vue `v-model`, Angular `[(value)]`.

**Events:** React `onChange`; Vue `change`; Angular .

**States:** `selected`, `disabled-item`.

### Props

Its own props, beside the common ones (`id`, `seed`, `ground`, `substrate`, `mode`, `palette`, `size`, `className`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | `readonly UiItem[]` |  | **Required.** The choices; each a native radio. Keys are unique (REQ-325). |
| `name` | `string` |  | **Required.** Required: the native radios submit under it (REQ-323). |
| `label` | `string` |  | **Required.** The group's name, its `<legend>`. |
| `orientation` | `UiOrientation` | `'vertical'` | Default `'vertical'`. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { SpRadioGroup } from '@silverpoint/react/ui/radio-group';

export function RadioGroupView() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<string>('silverpoint');
  return (
    <SpRadioGroup
      label="Ground"
      name="ground"
      items={[{ key: 'silverpoint', label: 'silverpoint' }, { key: 'cyanotype', label: 'cyanotype' }]}
      orientation="horizontal"
      value={value}
      onChange={setValue}
    />
  );
}
```

## SpTabs

`tabs` · Tabs and their panels (`SpTabPanel`), with automatic or manual activation. (navigation)

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `SpTabs` | `SpTabs` | `sp-tabs` | `sp_tabs` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/ui/tabs` | `@silverpoint/vue/ui/tabs` | `@silverpoint/angular/ui/tabs` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Value:** React `value + onChange`, Vue `v-model`, Angular `[(value)]`.

**Events:** React `onChange`; Vue `change`; Angular .

**Content:** React `children`; Vue `default`; Angular `content`.

**States:** `first`, `disabled-tab`.

### Props

Its own props, beside the common ones (`id`, `seed`, `ground`, `substrate`, `mode`, `palette`, `size`, `className`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | `readonly UiItem[]` |  | **Required.** The tabs; a disabled one is skipped by the arrows. Keys are unique (REQ-325). |

| `orientation` | `UiOrientation` | `'horizontal'` | Default `'horizontal'`. |
| `activation` | `'automatic' \| 'manual'` | `'automatic'` | Default `'automatic'`: a tab is selected as focus reaches it. |

### Example

      items={[{ key: 'overview', label: 'Overview' }, { key: 'traffic', label: 'Traffic' }, { key: 'errors', label: 'Errors' }, { key: 'settings', label: 'Settings' }]}
      value={value}
      onChange={setValue}
    />
  );
}

## SpTable

`table` · A data table with sortable columns, stripes and an empty state. (data-display)

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `SpTable` | `SpTable` | `sp-table` | `sp_table` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/ui/table` | `@silverpoint/vue/ui/table` | `@silverpoint/angular/ui/table` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Events:** React `onSort`; Vue `sort`; Angular `sort`.

**States:** `plain`, `sorted-striped`, `empty`.

### Props

Its own props, beside the common ones (`id`, `seed`, `ground`, `substrate`, `mode`, `palette`, `size`, `className`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | `readonly TableColumn[]` |  | **Required.** The columns, in order; each names the key it reads from a row. |
| `data` | `readonly Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>[]` |  | **Required.** The rows, drawn as given: the consumer sorts them (DD-040). |
| `caption` | `string` |  | The table's `<caption>`, its accessible name. |
| `sortKey` | `string` |  | A sortable column's key; another key sorts nothing, silently. |
| `sortOrder` | `'asc' \| 'desc'` | `'asc'` | Default `'asc'`. |
| `striped` | `boolean` | `false` | Default `false`. |
| `hoverable` | `boolean` | `true` | Default `true`. |
| `bordered` | `boolean` | `true` | Default `true`. |
| `emptyText` | `string` | `'No data'` | Default `'No data'`. |
| `rowKey` | `string` |  | The column whose value keys each row. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css';
import { SpTable } from '@silverpoint/react/ui/table';

export function TableView() {
  return (
    <SpTable
      caption="Orders"
      columns={[{ key: 'order', title: 'Order' }, { key: 'customer', title: 'Customer', sortable: true }, { key: 'status', title: 'Status' }, { key: 'amount', title: 'Amount', align: 'end', sortable: true }]}
      data={[{ order: '1042', customer: 'Ada Lovelace', status: 'Shipped', amount: 128 }, { order: '1043', customer: 'Grace Hopper', status: 'Packed', amount: 64.5 }, { order: '1044', customer: 'Alan Turing', status: 'Paid', amount: 312 }, { order: '1045', customer: 'Emmy Noether', status: 'Placed', amount: 18.25 }, { order: '1046', customer: 'Kurt Gödel', status: 'Shipped', amount: 96 }]}
      rowKey="order"
    />
  );
}
```

## SpPagination

`pagination` · Page navigation with a current page, siblings and an optional total. (navigation)

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `SpPagination` | `SpPagination` | `sp-pagination` | `sp_pagination` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/ui/pagination` | `@silverpoint/vue/ui/pagination` | `@silverpoint/angular/ui/pagination` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Value:** React `current + onChange`, Vue `v-model:current`, Angular `[(current)]`.

**Events:** React `onChange`; Vue ; Angular .

**States:** `middle`, `total`.

### Props

Its own props, beside the common ones (`id`, `seed`, `ground`, `substrate`, `mode`, `palette`, `size`, `className`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `total` | `number` |  | **Required.** The number of items paged over. |
| `pageSize` | `number` | `10` | Default `10`. |
| `siblings` | `number` | `1` | Pages shown on each side of the current one. Default `1`. |
| `showTotal` | `boolean` | `false` | Default `false`. |
| `totalTemplate` | `string` | `'{start}–{end} of {total}'` | Default `'{start}–{end} of {total}'`. |
| `label` | `string` | `'Pagination'` | Default `'Pagination'`. |
| `previousLabel` | `string` | `'Previous page'` | Default `'Previous page'`. |
| `nextLabel` | `string` | `'Next page'` | Default `'Next page'`. |
| `pageLabel` | `string` | `'Page'` | Default `'Page'`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Every page button disabled. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { SpPagination } from '@silverpoint/react/ui/pagination';

export function PaginationView() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<number>(10);
  return (
    <SpPagination
      total={200}
      pageSize={10}
      current={value}
      onChange={setValue}
    />
  );
}
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css';
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { SpPagination } from '@silverpoint/vue/ui/pagination';

const value = ref<number>(10);
</script>

<template>
  <SpPagination
    :total="200"
    :pageSize="10"
    v-model:current="value"
  />
</template>
```

```ts angular

import { SpPagination } from '@silverpoint/angular/ui/pagination';

/** Add '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css', '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css', '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css' to the `styles` of angular.json. */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-pagination-view',
  imports: [SpPagination],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <sp-pagination
      [total]="200"
      [pageSize]="10"
      [(current)]="value"
    />
  `,
})
export class PaginationView {
  protected readonly value = signal<number>(10);
}
```

export class TimelineListView {}

## SpTextarea

`textarea` · A multi-line text field with a counter and an invalid state. (data-entry)

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `SpTextarea` | `SpTextarea` | `sp-textarea` | `sp_textarea` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/ui/textarea` | `@silverpoint/vue/ui/textarea` | `@silverpoint/angular/ui/textarea` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Value:** React `value + onChange`, Vue `v-model`, Angular `[(value)]`.

**Events:** React `onChange`; Vue `change`; Angular .

**States:** `count`, `invalid`.

### Props

Its own props, beside the common ones (`id`, `seed`, `ground`, `substrate`, `mode`, `palette`, `size`, `className`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rows` | `number` | `3` | Default `3`. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  | Hint shown while empty; not a substitute for the accessible name. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name, when no `<label for>` names the control. |
| `message` | `string` |  | Help or error text under the control, referenced by `aria-describedby` (REQ-334). |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  | Sets `aria-invalid` and draws the exact ⚠ glyph (REQ-334). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Not focusable and not submitted. |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` |  | Focusable and submitted, but not editable. |
| `maxLength` | `number` |  | The native limit; the counter shows it with `showCount`. |
| `showCount` | `boolean` | `false` | Default `false`. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Form field name; the native textarea submits under it (REQ-323). |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { SpTextarea } from '@silverpoint/react/ui/textarea';

export function TextareaView() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<string>('Leave it at the door.');
  return (
    <SpTextarea
      label="Notes"
      name="notes"
      maxLength={120}
      showCount={true}
      value={value}
      onChange={setValue}
    />
  );
}
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css';
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { SpTextarea } from '@silverpoint/vue/ui/textarea';

const value = ref<string>('Leave it at the door.');
</script>

<template>
  <SpTextarea
    label="Notes"
    name="notes"
    :maxLength="120"
    :showCount="true"
    v-model="value"
  />
</template>
```

```ts angular
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { SpTextarea } from '@silverpoint/angular/ui/textarea';

/** Add '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css', '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css', '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css' to the `styles` of angular.json. */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-textarea-view',
  imports: [SpTextarea],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <sp-textarea
      [label]="'Notes'"
      [name]="'notes'"
      [maxLength]="120"
      [showCount]="true"
      [(value)]="value"
    />
  `,
})
export class TextareaView {
  protected readonly value = signal<string>('Leave it at the door.');
}
```

## SpInputNumber

`input-number` · A number field with steppers, bounds and precision. (data-entry)

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `SpInputNumber` | `SpInputNumber` | `sp-input-number` | `sp_input_number` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/ui/input-number` | `@silverpoint/vue/ui/input-number` | `@silverpoint/angular/ui/input-number` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Value:** React `value + onChange`, Vue `v-model`, Angular `[(value)]`.

**Events:** React `onChange`; Vue ; Angular .

**States:** `value`, `at-min`.

### Props

Its own props, beside the common ones (`id`, `seed`, `ground`, `substrate`, `mode`, `palette`, `size`, `className`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min` | `number` |  | The lowest value; the value is clamped to it (REQ-485). |
| `max` | `number` |  | The highest value; the value is clamped to it (REQ-485). |
| `step` | `number` | `1` | Default `1`. |
| `precision` | `number` |  | Decimals. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  | Hint shown while empty; not a substitute for the accessible name. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name, when no `<label for>` names the control. |
| `message` | `string` |  | Help or error text under the control, referenced by `aria-describedby` (REQ-334). |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  | Sets `aria-invalid` and draws the exact ⚠ glyph (REQ-334). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Not focusable and not submitted; the steppers are disabled too. |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` |  | Focusable and submitted, but not editable. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Form field name; the native input submits under it (REQ-323). |
| `decrementLabel` | `string` | `'Decrease'` | Default `'Decrease'`. |
| `incrementLabel` | `string` | `'Increase'` | Default `'Increase'`. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { SpInputNumber } from '@silverpoint/react/ui/input-number';

export function InputNumberView() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<number | null>(3);
  return (
    <SpInputNumber
      label="Quantity"
      name="quantity"
      min={1}
      max={10}
      value={value}
      onChange={setValue}
    />
  );
}
```

    label="Quantity"
    name="quantity"
    :min="1"
    :max="10"
    v-model="value"
